knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r Clean EGVI Table}
data
cleancols <- clean_names(data)
colnames(data)
EGVIcols <- cleancols[,c(2,5,7,17,258,260,281,283,285,287,289,291,293,295)]
colnames(EGVIcols)

colnames(EGVIcols)[1] <- "id"
colnames(EGVIcols)[2] <- "year"
colnames(EGVIcols)[3] <- "condition"
colnames(EGVIcols)[4] <- "duration"
colnames(EGVIcols)[5] <- "gcdur_L"
colnames(EGVIcols)[6] <- "gcdur_R"
colnames(EGVIcols)[7] <- "sls_L"
colnames(EGVIcols)[8] <- "sls_R"
colnames(EGVIcols)[9] <- "stance_L"
colnames(EGVIcols)[10] <- "stance_R"
colnames(EGVIcols)[11] <- "steptime_L"
colnames(EGVIcols)[12] <- "steptime_R"
colnames(EGVIcols)[13] <- "stridel_L"
colnames(EGVIcols)[14] <- "stridel_R"

colnames(EGVI_cols)
#### Creating new columns to match values required to calculate EGVI

EGVI_cols["stepl_L"] <- (EGVI_cols$stridel_L/2) * 100
EGVI_cols["stepl_R"] <- (EGVI_cols$stridel_R/2) * 100
EGVI_cols["stridev_L"] <-(EGVI_cols$stridel_L*100)/EGVI_cols$gcdur_L
EGVI_cols["stridev_R"] <- (EGVI_cols$stridel_R*100)/EGVI_cols$gcdur_R
EGVI_cols["slstime_L"] <- (EGVI_cols$sls_L/100)* EGVI_cols$gcdur_L
EGVI_cols["slstime_R"] <- (EGVI_cols$sls_R/100)* EGVI_cols$gcdur_R
EGVI_cols["stancet_L"] <- (EGVI_cols$stance_L/100)* EGVI_cols$gcdur_L
EGVI_cols["stancet_R"] <- (EGVI_cols$stance_R/100)* EGVI_cols$gcdur_R

EGVI_cols

```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
